t: Navigating the AI-Driven Web: URLinspector and the E-commerce Variant Dilemma
s: This article outlines a strategy for adapting to AI-driven web traffic by addressing the e-commerce 'Variant Dilemma' using URLinspector, emphasizing disciplined creative processes and technical hygiene for future-proofing websites against LLM bots.
sub: E-commerce Variant Dilemma (canonicalization vs. unfurling product pages)

The shift from traditional web pages to AI-driven content delivery (e.g., chatbots generating pages on the fly)
